synth.notes:
21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours: axis row ring 10 (centre 0 when selected), solid targets 11, pieces ring 5 (centre 0 when selected).
Reflections ring/centre 4 at row 2A-r for every off-axis piece block, skipping off-board and piece-occupied cells.
A1/A2 move selection one block up/down, A3/A4 move a selected piece left/right (blocked by edge/other pieces); A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis.
HUD column 63: one 11 -> 12 from the top per effective action; stateless.
Unconfirmed: whether the axis is blocked by piece rows (not exercised); A6/A7 unobserved.
